title: More text models, more uses
summary:
August broadened the text model lineup and community catalog while making image caching, access guidance, and request tracking more precise.

GPT-5, image-capable GPT-5 Nano, Claude 3.5 Haiku, OpenAI o3, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, DeepSeek R1 0528, and the tool-capable roblox-rp model joined the text work. DeepSeek reasoning also moved to a new route.

New listings covered multilingual chat, image generation, diagrams, and creative tools. Front-page generation counts returned, and a direct projects link made the catalog easier to reach.

The image cache moved to TypeScript and Hono, with exact and semantic matches separated. Multilingual embeddings and prompt-sensitive thresholds improved matching, while responses now identify which kind of cache hit occurred.

Beta tier guidance replaced obsolete Special Bee request links, and image docs were trimmed to match their current scope. Text tracking gained timing, usage, moderation, and tier data; completions now report `user_tier`.
